assumptions: Constructive legal activity actions with an explicit 5m garden budget from employment; favorable nonzero weather and solved detective puzzles. This proves paths exist, not that random play always wins. Tarot collection persists across lives.

garden.actions: Only buy in-season seeds, plant up to three plots, water with three seasonal care points, harvest, buy cooking staples, cook recipes in tier order. No stock or cooking counters injected.

detective.assumptions: Player solves the evidence puzzle; test uses the solver to choose valid clues within normal hours, rather than assigning solved/reputation counters.

tarot.condition: One selected card per yearly reading; 78 readings minimum across one or several lives. Collection persists across lives; reaching it in one life also requires survival.
